authorization_scope_at_publication: Analyze completed P10 and publish next plan; implementation and server launch occur when the user supplies the startup prompt to Codex.
objective: Compare independent root-height residual with a root-height update tied to predicted vertical velocity, while continuing full-library learning and preserving acquired skills.
acceptance: LAFAN full40 R>=0.82 is already accepted as reproduced. This research does not add acceptance requirements or revoke that success.

established: P10 hard quota reached real collection, effective WM windows and Actor starts.
Side roll21/22 and cartwheel85/120 improved; flip0/44 and handstand0/160 persist.
P10 selected imagined transitions at actual iterations18846,20761,26303 include z-vz inconsistency under positive/high pre-reward survival.
limits: Selected trajectories are biased by Critic error and have no matched real future; they do not estimate population error or prove the cause of all failures.
Published six same-action WM windows use P9 full9000, not P10 final27000.
Endpoint trapezoidal integration is an approximate prior, not exact MuJoCo four-substep integration or an author-published formula.
evidence.current_parent_evidence_timing: Once before either P11 training process starts, evaluate the seven frozen existing P10 hard27000 true action windows with the original parent WM. Record findings; do not change the fixed pair, add windows or parameter sweeps automatically.

execution.cpu_preparation: None; reuse original P9 immutable CPU read-only memmap and manifests, including the original hard mapping.
execution.startup_order: Implement required changes; compute seven parent windows under the existing shared lock; start control as a real job, complete its one-time fill and enter joint updates, then immediately start candidate as a real job.

resource_basis.interpretation: Memory current includes reclaimable page cache. Host /proc memory is not the container limit. No environment-count increase or capacity benchmark.

execution.resource_reporting: At normal startup/publication nodes include GPU process and allocated/reserved usage, original timing, cgroup memory.max/current and memory.stat anon/file/inactive_file; no new monitoring service.

parent.initial_reset: Construct with reset_on_init=false; restore sampler and saved RNG before first real reset, following implemented P10 behavior.
parent.stage_statistics: New P11 counters start at zero; actual same-run resumes continue P11 counters and consumed time. A user handoff does not restart the live process.

single_variable.predicted_vz_next: World-frame vertical velocity from the same existing WM forward; no true next-state velocity, reference velocity, new model or teacher forcing.
single_variable.unused_original_dp_z: Keep output slot and parameters; omit its contribution to candidate z without deleting or resetting the head.
single_variable.semantic_recording: Candidate changes the WM forward despite full parameter/optimizer resume. Save mode in actual config/checkpoint and apply it in learner and all fixed-window model loaders. Legacy checkpoints mean residual.
single_variable.not_success_metric: Candidate kinematic residual is zero by construction; use actual real-control and matched real-trajectory prediction metrics.

common_training.sampling_semantics: Two source groups, three overlapping reset strata; hard remains in bones_all; one shared restored G/M and one EMA update per original source, no duplicate hard-source update.
common_training.lr_schedule: Continue inherited global cosine schedule unchanged; no batch-based LR increase.
common_training.reference_store: Exact existing P9 CPU read-only mmap; no repack, rescreen, copy or new download. Goal context window43 frames.
common_training.other_parameters: Preserve actual P10 hard27000 config: reward, physical termination, PD, action scale, observation/action noise, randomization, history, architecture and optimizer settings.

budget.stop_rule: First of9000 new joint updates or20h accumulated new stage training time; no automatic extension.
budget.parent_history_evaluation_evidence_publi: Record separately; elapsed training still includes slowdown from shared resource contention.
budget.scope: Budget is a research comparison, not evidence of convergence or reproduction progress percentage.

model_instances: parent hard27000 original WM before training
fixed_real_windows.comparison: Same recorded true initial qpos/qvel/previous_action/context33, reference frames and executed actions. Feed model state recursively after the first state.
fixed_real_windows.bias: All seven are existing selected real failures, not a population sample.

normal_training_statistics.wm: Reuse k8 predicted/target states and existing error tensors; accumulate true/pred r_z and real z/vz/SO3 prediction error with counts.
normal_training_statistics.actor: Reuse H32 states and detach pre-reward S_t; accumulate sumS, sum(S*r), sum(S*abs(r)), sum(S*r*r), plus natural-end counts. No new hard threshold or epsilon.
normal_training_statistics.bin_key: original_BONES_source_clip_id and floor(start_reference_frame/50); crossing WM windows and all their errors belong to the start bin.
normal_training_statistics.bin_metrics_use_existing_errors: z coordinate2; velocity-z coordinate37 in70-error layout has /3 scaling, so square error times9 restores physical units; rotation sum over3:6. Use actual existing tensor layout when implementing.
normal_training_statistics.selected_rollouts: Keep existing at most4 already-computed examples per1000 updates; add mode/residual metadata, no extra sampling.
normal_training_statistics.flush: Accumulate detached tensors on device, transfer compact sums and counts at existing1000-update blocks or formal milestones; avoid per-step CPU synchronization.

evaluation.parent27000: Reuse existing P10 hard endpoint full BONES and LAFAN results.
evaluation.actual_endpoint: Both full BONES and LAFAN once if time cap stops outside a scheduled node; reuse already published same-checkpoint results.
evaluation.protocol: All130394 BONES motions from frame0 until physical termination or natural end; no training500-step evaluation cutoff; normalization0.1*(N-1); stable length/source-id grouping and original-id output order.
evaluation.different_time_cap_endpoints: Report each endpoint and compare already available common scheduled nodes; do not add training or extra physics to manufacture equal iterations.
evaluation.tail_capture: At actual endpoint only, reuse P10 bounded selection from the same formal rollout: at most8 BONES tails, first2 original ids in each predeclared group; LAFAN failed tails from same evaluation. No separate physics replay.
evaluation.scalars: CSV every1000 clips with all failures retained; reuse existing score schema and small summaries.
evaluation.decision: Candidate can improve, trade off abilities, or show no benefit within this budget. Zero kinematic residual is not success; neither selected examples nor lower loss alone establishes better control.

anchors.general_quality: P10 full8k_control checkpoint27000, existing results only
anchors.lafan_effect: P9 LAFAN original-Critic checkpoint60000, existing results only

publication.status_fields: Refresh current latest_training and observed iteration from actual end data; distinguish historical snapshots, training completion, evaluation completion and publication completion. Do not leave not_started after completion.
